mapper.select: SELECT id_medico as idMedico, nombre, primer_apellido as primerApellido, segundo_apellido as segundoApellido, DATE_FORMAT(fecha_nacimiento, '%d/%m/%Y') as fechaNacimiento, sexo, id_domicilio as idDomicilio, no_personal as noPersonal, cedula_profesional as cedulaProfesional, es_administrador as esAdministrador, estatus, fotografia FROM medico WHERE no_personal = #{noPersonal} AND contrasena = SHA2(#{contrasena}, 256)
